context: A bright autumn afternoon at the park. Hina has found a red leaf and is showing it proudly to her grandfather Goro on the bench.
purpose: small wonder shared between child and grandparent — affection through attention

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、見て見て！すごく赤いよ！
lines.en: Grandpa, look look! It's really red!
lines.style: High child pitch racing forward with delight, the second 「見て」 spiking even brighter than the first.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: おお、本当だ。きれいな葉っぱだなあ。
lines.en: Oh, really now. What a pretty leaf.
lines.style: Low warm grandpa voice, slow approving exhale, the 「なあ」 stretched out with gentle pride.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 一番きれいなの選んだの！
lines.style: Quick proud burst, child voice climbing on 「一番」 with a small triumphant lift.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: うん、よく見つけたね。ひなちゃんは目がいいなあ。
lines.en: Yes, you found it well. Hina has a good eye.
lines.style: Soft chuckle threaded through the praise, deliberate elder pacing on each compliment landing gently.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: えへへ、ありがとう。じゃあ、おじいちゃんにあげる！
lines.en: Heehee, thank you. Then, I'll give it to grandpa!
lines.style: Bright giggling chirp, then a generous decisive offering tone on the second half quickening forward.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: いいのかい？大事にするよ。ありがとうな。
lines.en: Are you sure? I'll treasure it. Thank you.
lines.style: Tender slow grandpa cadence, slight catch on the thanks, real gratitude in a quiet weighted voice.
